eula.title: Contact Points: Terms and Conditions
eula.contents:
Please read all the Terms and Conditions carefully
  1. Kobool Contact Point is a digital product that you can use only to start writing and reading messages to and from the member you matched with via Kobool Mutual Acceptance Matching operation.
  2. You can not use the Contact Point to contact any Kobool member other than the one you are matched with.
  3. Upon buying the Contact Point, it would be added to your Kobool profile and will remain usable until you use it by clicking the "Use this point" button that is displayed next to your usable Points.
  4. Usable Contact Points never expire until they are used.
  5. Two Contact Points are required per Mutual Acceptance Connection to have full communication.
    You are responsible for "one" Contact Point and your matched member is responsible for the other one.
  6. Upon buying and using your Contact Point you will immediately be able to write messages to your matched member. But your match will not be able to read your written messages unless he/she buy and use his Contact Point.
  7. You may choose to buy and use "two" Contact Points to activate full communication with your match if your match is unable or doesn't like to buy a Contact Point or if you like to make it as a gift to your match.
  8. After using a Contact Point, it can not be re-used again if any of the following happens:
    • Your contact with the matched member is still active.
    • You sent at least one written text message and your match could read it.
    • Your match sent at least one written text message and you read it.
    • You or your match declined from the Mutual Acceptance Connection and used written text message in the Decline Form.
  9. If none of the above condition is valid, your point can be re-used in future matches upon declining from the Mutual Acceptance Connection that you used the Contact Points for.
  10. Currently, it is "not" possible for Kobool to refund the price of the purchased Contact Points to their owners.
    Soon, Kobool will implement a method for Contact Points owners to be able to sell the points or give them as gifts to other Kobool members when they want to.

qa.title: Contact Points: Questions and Answers
qa.contents:
What happens if I purchase and use a Contact Card but my matched member doesn't do the same thing?
Upon buying and using your Kobool Contact Card you will immediately be able to write messages to your matched member. But your match will not be able to read your written messages untill he/she buys and uses a Contact Card.
If your match didn't use a Contact Card and one of you decided to decline, your purchased Card will become re-usable for future Mutual Acceptance matches if Decline message was a predefined one.
Does my Contact Card expire after a specific number of written messages or after a period of time?
After using the two Contact Cards Your communication with your match via written messages will not be terminated and will always be on, unless one of you decides to decline from your relationship.
If I purchased and used one Contact Card and my matched member didn't, will I be able to send a written decline message to him/her?
You can only decline with sending written decline message when the two Contact Cards are used.
But, you can use one of the predefined Decline messages.
How can I buy Kobool Contact Cards in Egypt using cash money?
Currently Kobool Contact Cards can only be bought through www.kobool.com web site.
To buy Kobool Contact Card using cash money you can buy CashU card 250 with your cash money and then use it to buy Kobool Card.
CashU cards are available in most Middle Eastern cities. You can order it from your nearest distibuter by telephone and ask them to deliver it to your home.
Click here to find the nearest CashU Cards distributer to your area.
I live in a small town in Egypt, How can I buy Kobool Contact Card and how much does it cost in Egyptian bound?
You can buy CashU card using cash money and use it to buy Kobool Contact Card through kobool.com website.
CashU cards can be delivered to your home in most cities in Egypt and Arabic countries
Click here to find the nearest distributer to your area.
Kobool Contact Card requires one CashU 250 card which costs 5 US dollar or about 28 Egyptian bound.
I live in Sweden, do you have offices or outlets I can go to to buy Contact Cards? Or a bank account that I can transfer to it the money required to buy Contact Cards?
In the time being we don't have outlets or offices that sell Kobool Contact Cards. Also, we don't have a bank account set up to recieve money on it for Contact Cards sales. We will unlikely setup such bank account because the price of a Kobool Contact Card is only 5 US dollar. Propably the cost of the money transfer will cost higher than this amount.
If you have any type of credit cards, you can use it directly to buy the Kobool Card.
If you don't have any credit cards, the only option for you in Sweden is to ask one of your friends who owns a credit card to buy the Kobool Card for you and you can pay him back later.
In the middle of this page you can find the link you have to send to your friend to use it to buy the Kobool Card so that it will be directly added to your Kobool account.
